item.title: Mean Girl Behavior Has No Place in Adulthood
item.description: Grown women making fun of other women on social media is giving high school mean girl energy. It's time to leave the judgment and public ridicule behind.

item.title: When Your Friend Talks With Their Eyes Off the Road
item.description: Tammin Sursok rides with that one friend who keeps turning to make eye contact while talking, leaving the passenger wondering if they should be watching the road instead.

item.title: POV: You're Overstimulated and Your Family Won't Stop
item.description: Tammin Sursok captures the feeling of being completely overstimulated while everyone around you keeps talking, shouting, and making noise. A relatable moment for anyone who needs a little quiet.

item.title: If I Was Kidnapped as a Mom at 40
item.description: Tammin Sursok imagines how a 40-year-old mom would react to being kidnapped, worrying about her schedule, questioning everything, and making sure everyone else is taken care of.
